title: Journey into Nyx: Godsend, Part II

paragraphs.text: Journey into Nyx: Godsend, Part II is an e-book that tells the official story of the Theros block . It was written by Jenna Helland and was published on May 13, 2014.

The great hydra Polukranos is dead, slain by the Planeswalker Elspeth , champion of the sun god . Now the gods turn their faces from Theros , and the machinations of the satyr Planeswalker Xenagos are coming to fruition...
